opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support. Undergraduate Student Members, Affiliates and Partner Scientists not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access. 2026 Round 2 opens 12 October 2026 and closes 30 November 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members of Partner Scientist, Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories at submission and for grant duration; PhD students in chemical sciences or researchers in chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education. Partner Scientist members must have been a member for at least 180 days before the round.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists in industry and academia to undertake an activity supporting their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses or organising scientific meetings. 2026 Round 4 opens 14 September 2026 and closes 19 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or those outside with valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs of care they usually provide. Rolling applications, up to £1,200 per year.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or those outside with valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must use funds to cover support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports individuals with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering costs of specific support such as accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support and assistive software/hardware. Rolling applications, up to £1,200 per year.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement and outreach activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences. Open for applications throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026 at 5pm. Prioritises projects engaging under-represented audiences, developing RSC members' engagement skills, and supporting positive social outcomes.
